Spacecraft name SCION (SCintillation and Ionospheric Occultation Nanosats)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 1U
Entity name University of Michigan
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Nation US
Oneliner

Make multipoint, GPS TEC and scintillation observations of the ionosphere.
Description

A CubeSat–based mission designed to make multipoint, GPS TEC and scintillation observations of the ionosphere on the ~1 km spatial scales associated with communication and navigation system degradation.
